rust_summary: a native mod's item panel drawn with a recipe viewer's page buttons and search box, or laid out as JEI 1.12's (`native_panel_style`).
doc_summary: `native_panel_style(mod_id, style)` (client) chooses how mod `mod_id`'s item panel (`native_panel_items`) draws its page buttons and search box: `NativePanelStyle::RecipeBook` (the default: the recipe book's page arrows and a plain search box) or `NativePanelStyle::Viewer` (square page buttons on a bar over the items and the viewer's search box, as Horizon's Recipes panel draws them), so a recipe viewer port looks like one, or `NativePanelStyle::Classic { centred_search, window_width }` (JEI's look on Minecraft 1.12: the items flush right under page buttons that always show and wrap around, the search box at the foot of the screen, under the window when `centred_search` and there is room, with a settings button that opens the mod's page in Options > Mods; `window_width` lays the panel out beside a centred window that wide). The viewer's look only changes the drawing; the classic one also lays the panel out as JEI did. Kept for the session. Bundles need "hooks": @API:panel_style@.
